name: javscope
description: Highlight the current bracket scope with configurable per-level decoration

javscope.bracketSquare.description: Enable scope highlighting for square brackets [ ]

javscope.highlightExtend.description: Extend highlight to cover entire lines

javscope.languages.description: Per-language overrides. Keys are language IDs, values are objects with bracket type flags (parentheses, braces, squareBrackets).

javscope.scopeIndentedOnly.description: Only highlight scopes whose opening bracket is indented

javscope.scopeLevels.description: Decoration config per nesting level (index 0 = innermost scope). Each entry supports colorBackground, colorBorder, borderWidth, borderStyle, colorOverview, colorEnd.

colorBorder.description: Border color for scope range (empty string = no border)

borderStyle.description: CSS border style (solid, dashed, dotted, etc.)

colorOverview.description: Color shown in the overview ruler

colorEnd.description: Background color for the opening/closing bracket characters
